items.en: Hormuz Talks 'Positive', Oman Says, but Iran Warns a Deal Would Not Reopen the Strait
items.zh: 阿曼稱荷姆茲海峽談判有進展，伊朗卻警告協議不等於重新開放海峽
items.summary: Oman, acting as mediator, says talks on agreeing a new shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz have been positive, but Iran has warned that any deal would not amount to reopening the strait itself. Both sides suggest progress, yet a breakthrough remains unclear. The strait carries roughly a fifth of the world's seaborne oil, so even partial arrangements move energy markets: Brent settled at $82.21 and WTI at $77.08 on Friday, both slightly lower, partly on hopes of an easing. For Asian importers such as Taiwan, Japan and South Korea, the shipping-insurance premium matters as much as the headline crude price.

items.en: Trump's Former Defence Lawyer Todd Blanche Narrowly Confirmed as US Attorney General
items.zh: 川普前刑事辯護律師布蘭奇險過關，出任美國司法部長
items.summary: The US Senate has narrowly confirmed Todd Blanche, Donald Trump's former criminal defence lawyer, as attorney general. The vote cements a close personal ally as the nation's top law enforcement official, and came despite rare pushback from several Republican senators who questioned whether a president's own defence counsel can independently supervise federal prosecutors. Democrats framed the confirmation as an erosion of the Justice Department's traditional distance from the White House. Blanche will now oversee ongoing federal cases, civil-rights enforcement and antitrust policy, including several technology investigations.

items.en: Child Among Three Killed in Russian Missile Attacks Near Kyiv
items.zh: 俄羅斯飛彈襲擊基輔近郊，三死其中一名為孩童
items.summary: Three people, including a child, were killed in Russian missile attacks near Kyiv as Moscow continued overnight strikes. The attacks followed a warning from President Volodymyr Zelensky that Ukraine's stocks of missile interceptors are running low, a constraint that shapes how much of each incoming salvo can be shot down. Ukrainian emergency workers have separately reported a rise in strikes hitting hospitals and ambulances. The pattern of recent weeks has shifted towards factories, warehouses and energy infrastructure, suggesting an attempt to degrade Ukraine's industrial capacity before winter.

items.en: Typhoon Dolphin Makes Landfall in Zhejiang After Battering Okinawa; Taiwan Now Clear
items.zh: 白海豚颱風重創沖繩後於 8/9 下午登陸浙江玉環，台灣脫離暴風圈
items.summary: Typhoon Dolphin made landfall on Sunday afternoon near Yuhuan in Zhejiang province, China, with maximum sustained winds around force 14, after cutting power to at least 44,000 buildings and injuring five people on Japan's Okinawa. Saturday and Sunday were the storm's closest approach to Taiwan, bringing heavy rain to northern and mountain areas and a coastal-flooding risk along the Keelung and north coast at spring tide. From Monday the system moves away and Taiwan turns to a southwesterly flow, with forecasters warning of extreme heat instead.

items.en: Israel Accused of Weaponising Archaeology at Ancient West Bank Sites
items.zh: 以色列被指「把考古當武器」，計劃大規模徵收約旦河西岸歷史區土地
items.summary: Israel is planning large-scale land expropriations covering historic Palestinian areas of the occupied West Bank, in what critics describe as weaponising archaeology. Under the plans, sites of archaeological significance would be brought under Israeli administrative control, a designation that in practice restricts Palestinian building and farming on the surrounding land. Israeli officials present the measures as heritage protection. Palestinian and international heritage bodies argue the designations follow settlement boundaries more closely than they follow the archaeology, and warn of a precedent for using cultural protection as a territorial instrument.

items.en: Is Football AI-Proof? Why Tech Investors Wanted a Slice of the World Cup
items.zh: 足球是「AI 免疫」資產？科技投資人為何搶著入股世界盃
items.summary: After Fifa's aborted attempt to sell private stakes in the World Cup, the BBC examines why technology investors were so interested in the first place. The pitch was that live sport is one of the few forms of content that generative AI cannot manufacture or substitute: the result is genuinely unknown, the audience wants it live, and the rights are scarce and legally defensible. That scarcity logic is now driving capital across live entertainment. The deal collapsed under governance criticism, but bankers involved suggest similar proposals for other sporting bodies are close to inevitable.

items.en: Raw Images, No Filters: Why MySpace Fans Want It Back as a Relaunch Is Hinted
items.zh: 沒有濾鏡的粗糙感：MySpace 傳將重啟，老用戶要的是「不被演算法決定」
items.summary: Hints of a MySpace relaunch have prompted a wave of nostalgia from fans and creators, who say a revived version must feel personal rather than algorithm-driven. The appeal being described is specific: user-controlled page layouts, chronological feeds, unfiltered images, and a top-friends list chosen by the person rather than inferred by a recommender system. The interest arrives as regulators price the cost of engagement-optimised design, and as younger users report fatigue with feeds tuned for retention. Whether a relaunch can be commercially viable without those mechanics is the open question.

items.en: What It's Like to Chase Total Solar Eclipses Around the World
items.zh: 追日食的人：為了幾分鐘的全食，他們飛越半個地球
items.summary: For most people a total solar eclipse is a once-in-a-lifetime event, but a dedicated community plans years ahead to stand inside the path of totality, travelling to remote coastlines, deserts and ships at sea. The BBC follows eclipse chasers who describe the few minutes of totality, when the corona becomes visible and the temperature drops, as unlike any other observable phenomenon. The hobby has become increasingly data-driven, with chasers using cloud-cover climatology and high-resolution shadow-path modelling to choose observing sites months in advance.

items.en: Fifa Hits Back at 'Concerted Effort' to Oust President Gianni Infantino
items.zh: 國際足總反擊：稱有「有組織的行動」要拉下主席因凡蒂諾
items.summary: Fifa has strongly criticised what it calls a concerted and ongoing effort to undermine the organisation and its president, Gianni Infantino. The statement follows multiple calls for Infantino to resign after his aborted plan to sell private stakes in the World Cup, and reports that Uefa is preparing an inquiry. Infantino has separately denied allegations that Uefa paid off an alleged former partner. Sunday newspapers reported Uefa is set to formally examine the matter, meaning the dispute is now between the two most powerful bodies in European and world football.

items.en: Tielemans Cameo Against PSG Hints at Manchester United Future
items.zh: 提勒曼斯對巴黎聖日耳曼替補登場驚豔，暗示曼聯新賽季用法
items.summary: Manchester United's £35m signing Youri Tielemans made an impressive debut in a 1-1 pre-season friendly against Paris St-Germain in Gothenburg. Introduced from the bench, the Belgium midfielder immediately raised United's tempo in possession and offered the controlled progression the side lacked last season. The cameo was short but pointed: against the European champions' press, Tielemans was the player most comfortable receiving under pressure. With the Premier League season days away, the performance strengthens the case for starting him in a deeper role.

items.en: Callum Simpson Avenges Only Career Loss in Williamson Rematch
items.zh: 辛普森復仇成功，點數擊敗威廉森奪回英國暨大英國協超中量級金腰帶
items.summary: Callum Simpson reclaimed the British and Commonwealth super-middleweight titles with a unanimous decision over Troy Williamson, avenging the only defeat of his professional career. Simpson boxed with more discipline than in the first meeting, controlling range behind the jab rather than trading, and banked the early rounds before absorbing Williamson's pressure late. The win restores his standing in a domestic division that has become one of British boxing's most competitive, and puts a world-title eliminator back within reach.

items.en: Top UK Universities Cut Entry Grades as International Student Numbers Drop 10%
items.zh: 英國頂尖大學降低入學門檻，國際生人數下滑一成是主因
items.summary: The Sunday Times reports that leading UK institutions are becoming more flexible on entry grades following a 10% fall in international student numbers. Universities that historically held firm on offer conditions are now widening the band of accepted results, a shift driven by the funding gap that international fees previously filled. The change lands days before A-level results day, altering the calculus for applicants who narrowly miss their offers. Sector bodies caution that flexibility concentrated in a funding crisis is not the same as a durable widening-participation policy.

items.en: Your University Clearing Survival Guide Ahead of Results Day
items.zh: 放榜前的補錄取生存指南：先列出所有可能結果，再拿起電話
items.summary: Ahead of A-level results day, the BBC sets out how to get the most out of clearing, the process that matches applicants to remaining university places. The practical advice is to map every possible outcome in advance rather than react on the day, to research alternative courses before results are published, and to phone admissions offices personally rather than rely on online forms. Counsellors emphasise that the emotional preparation matters as much as the logistics: students who have rehearsed the worst-case scenario make markedly better decisions under time pressure.

items.en: How Weight-Loss Medication Is Changing People's Relationship with Alcohol
items.zh: 減重藥意外改變了人與酒精的關係：想喝的念頭消失了
items.summary: People taking GLP-1 weight-loss medication increasingly report that their cravings for alcohol disappeared, or that drinking made them feel nauseous. Researchers say the drugs act on reward pathways in the brain rather than only on appetite, which would explain effects extending beyond food. Formal trials of GLP-1 drugs for alcohol use disorder are under way, but clinicians stress the evidence is early and the medications are not approved for that purpose. The accounts have nonetheless reopened a longstanding question about how much of craving is metabolic rather than purely psychological.

items.en: Claude Voice Mode Ships Across Opus, Sonnet and Haiku with Gmail and Slack Connectors
items.zh: Claude 語音模式 8/8 全系列上線，可直接連 Gmail、Slack，並大幅擴充語言
items.summary: Anthropic shipped voice mode across the Claude Opus, Sonnet and Haiku model tiers on 8 August, with connections to tools including Gmail and Slack and support for many additional languages. Claude Code received a separate batch of updates the same week, adding gateway spend-limit support for usage warnings, workspace trust prompts for agents, remote-control message starts by name, and improved photo handling. The direction is consistent across vendors: the differentiator is shifting from raw model quality to how cleanly the assistant reaches a user's existing accounts and tools.

items.en: IonQ Revenue Jumps 287% to $80.1m as Quantum Names Rally Into Earnings
items.zh: IonQ 第二季營收暴增 287% 至 8,010 萬美元，量子三雄集體反彈
items.summary: IonQ reported record second-quarter revenue of $80.1m, up 287% year on year, and raised full-year guidance to $290m. It also signed a memorandum of understanding with Sandia National Laboratories on quantum co-design for US national security on 5 August, won a $28m DARPA contract extension for 125 compact optical atomic clocks, and a National Reconnaissance Office contract for synthetic aperture radar services. Rigetti secured up to $100m in potential CHIPS Act funding and holds $569m in cash with no debt. All three major listed quantum names have recovered from steep June and July losses.

items.en: TSMC Reportedly Circling AUO's Taichung Fabs as Advanced-Packaging Land Grab Intensifies
items.zh: 台積電傳洽購友達中科 L5C、L7 廠房，先進封裝搶地大戰白熱化
items.summary: Taiwanese media report that TSMC has been in contact with AUO over its L5C and L7 plants in the Central Taiwan Science Park, part of a broader scramble for advanced-packaging space. AUO is said to have listed four production lines for asset activation with a goal of disposing of all of them within a year; the company calls the reports pure speculation. TSMC, Siliconware and others are hunting for suitable buildings in Taichung because packaging capacity, not wafer capacity, is the current bottleneck for AI accelerators. Panel-level packaging makes former display fabs unusually well suited.
items.source: 經濟日報 / 商業周刊 / CMoney

items.en: Official Hige Dandism Bring Their 2026 Asia Tour to Taipei Arena on 29–30 August
items.zh: ★ Official髭男dism 亞洲巡演台北小巨蛋 8/29–8/30 兩場，本月底就到！
items.summary: Official Hige Dandism have announced OFFICIAL HIGE DANDISM ASIA TOUR 2026, running through Seoul's KSPO Dome on 8–9 August, Singapore's The Star Theatre on 21 August, and Taipei Arena on 29–30 August. The Taipei dates are the closest stop on your list this month and fall on a Saturday and Sunday, so no clash with the new semester. Two nights at Taipei Arena is a step up from their previous Taiwan appearances and reflects how far the band's streaming base has grown across Asia since Subtitle and Pretender.

items.en: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour Opens Overseas Leg in Kaohsiung on 31 October
items.zh: ★ 藤井風《Prema》世界巡演海外首站：10/31 高雄國家體育場
items.summary: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour will open its overseas leg at Kaohsiung National Stadium on Saturday 31 October at 19:00, making him the first Japanese solo artist to headline the 40,000-capacity venue. Tickets went on sale on 20 June at noon through KKTIX and FamiPort, priced from NT$1,800 to NT$5,800; KKTIX is the only officially authorised channel, so resale and proxy-purchase offers should be treated with caution. The Hong Kong date previously listed for this tour has been cancelled, leaving Kaohsiung as the nearest stop.

items.en: YOASOBI Confirm a 10-City Asia Dome and Stadium Tour Spanning 2026–2027
items.zh: ★ YOASOBI 公布亞洲 10 城巨蛋／體育場巡演，台灣、香港、新加坡、韓國都在名單內
items.summary: YOASOBI have confirmed an Asia 10-City Dome & Stadium Tour for 2026–2027, covering five Japanese cities — Osaka, Aichi, Fukuoka, Hokkaido and Tokyo — plus Taiwan, South Korea, Hong Kong, Singapore and others. It is the duo's largest-scale routing to date and moves them from arenas into dome and stadium capacity across the region. Specific Taiwan dates and the on-sale schedule have not been published yet, so it is worth setting an alert now rather than waiting for the general announcement.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE Add Stadium Dates While Vaundy Announces His First Asia Arena Tour
items.zh: ★ Mrs. GREEN APPLE 加開國立競技場場次；Vaundy 首次亞洲巡迴「HORO」啟動
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's 2026 run, Zenjin Mito to Immutable — Interlude Edition, is scheduled for the National Stadium in Tokyo on 18–19 April and 4–5 July, and Yanmar Stadium Nagai in Osaka on 4–5 May, with total attendance projected around 320,000 and a live-viewing broadcast planned for the final show. Separately, Vaundy has announced HORO, his first ever Asia arena tour. Between these two and the Hige Dandism and YOASOBI routings, four acts from your list are now touring Asia within the same window.
